text: The README promises that output built without fresh data says so in `notice`, and stale data never passes silently. This change serves a timetable whose refresh failed with no notice, and the new test asserts `row["notice"] is None`, which locks in the silent behaviour. Keep the fallback to the saved copy, but make it add a notice that the timetable is a saved copy because the refresh failed (the existing notice path for stale or partial data is a good model). Change the test to assert that the notice is present and keep the exit-code check.
